<var>
$DPS$ = Damage * Pellet Count / (Firerate + Pump Time)

$GDPS$ = Damage / Firerate
$CE$ = Total Price / DPS
$MCE$ = Total Price / Max DPS
$ACE$ = Total Price / Top Path Stats.DPS
$TP$ = $FNC-TOTALPRICE$
$TE$ = $FNC-TOTAL-EXP$
$EXP$ = {{#expr:floor(75 * 1.075^(Level - 1) * (Level > 0))}}

$FSE-META$ = Evolved; File:DefaultEnforcer0.png

$RC$ = $FNC-RECURSION$
